templateOptions.label: ClientId
templateOptions.description: The client ID of the machine-to-machine client in the Unit4 Identity Server

templateOptions.label: ClientSecret
templateOptions.description: The client secret of the machine-to-machine client

templateOptions.label: TokenUrl
templateOptions.description: The token endpoint of the Unit4 Identity Server, for example: https://example.com/identity/connect/token

templateOptions.label: Scope
templateOptions.description: The OAuth scope for the Unit4 ERPx API

templateOptions.label: BaseUrl
templateOptions.description: The URL to the Unit4 ERPx API, for example: https://example.com

templateOptions.label: CompanyId
templateOptions.description: The Unit4 ERPx company (administration) used for all calls, the default role and company entry and the roles

templateOptions.label: ContactPointType
templateOptions.description: The contactPointType of the user contact point that holds the e-mail address. Leave empty to create the contact point without a type

templateOptions.label: Add default role and company on create
templateOptions.description: When enabled, create sends one roleAndCompany entry for CompanyId (with personId and DefaultRoleId) and sets defaultLogonCompany to CompanyId

templateOptions.label: DefaultRoleId
templateOptions.description: The roleId of the default role and company entry. Leave empty to send the entry without a role
